evidence: Modifies src/index/txindex.cpp and src/index/txindex.h to support index operation on pruned nodes.
rationale: Enables txindex on pruned nodes, resolving four long-standing user issues dating back to 2017 (#10609, #12651, #16182, #35240). By eliminating the requirement to retain hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history for transaction lookups and proof generation, this provides durable, substantial user-facing value for node operators with limited disk space.
